words.def: Large in amount or importance.
words.ex: The company made a substantial profit this year.
words.exfa: این شرکت امسال سود قابل‌توجهی کسب کرد.

words.def: Basic and very important.
words.ex: Education is a fundamental human right.
words.exfa: تعلیم و تربیه یک حق بنیادی انسان است.

words.def: A result of an action, often a negative one.
words.ex: Every decision has consequences.
words.exfa: هر تصمیم پیامدهایی دارد.

words.def: To put a plan or a decision into action.
words.ex: The government will implement the new policy next year.
words.exfa: حکومت پالیسی جدید را سال آینده عملی خواهد کرد.

words.def: Important enough to be noticed.
words.ex: There was a significant increase in prices.
words.exfa: افزایش چشمگیری در قیمت‌ها رخ داد.

words.def: Able to continue for a long time without harming the environment.
words.ex: We need sustainable farming methods.
words.exfa: ما به روش‌های زراعتی پایدار ضرورت داریم.

words.def: To discuss something in order to reach an agreement.
words.ex: They negotiated a new contract.
words.exfa: آنها یک قرارداد جدید را مذاکره کردند.

words.def: To judge the quality or value of something.
words.ex: Teachers assess students with exams.
words.exfa: معلمان شاگردان را با امتحان ارزیابی میکنند.

words.def: An idea that explains something but is not yet proved.
words.ex: The researchers tested their hypothesis.
words.exfa: محققان فرضیهٔ خود را آزمایش کردند.

words.def: A general rise in prices over time.
words.ex: High inflation makes life harder for families.
words.exfa: تورم بلند زندگی را برای فامیل‌ها دشوارتر میسازد.

words.def: Money that a business or a government receives.
words.ex: The shop's revenue doubled last year.
words.exfa: عواید دوکان سال گذشته دو برابر شد.

words.def: Extremely important.
words.ex: Good sleep is crucial for learning.
words.exfa: خواب خوب برای یادگیری حیاتی است.

words.def: To succeed in dealing with a problem.
words.ex: She had to overcome many difficulties to finish school.
words.exfa: او برای تکمیل مکتب باید بر مشکلات زیادی غلبه میکرد.

words.def: Not willing to do something.
words.ex: He was reluctant to leave his hometown.
words.exfa: او برای ترک زادگاهش بی‌میل بود.

words.def: Including everything that is needed.
words.ex: The report gives a comprehensive view of the problem.
words.exfa: این گزارش دید جامعی دربارهٔ مشکل میدهد.

words.def: To make something better or stronger.
words.ex: Reading can enhance your vocabulary.
words.exfa: مطالعه میتواند لغات تو را بیشتر کند.

words.def: Having more than one possible meaning.
words.ex: The instructions were ambiguous and confusing.
words.exfa: رهنمودها مبهم و گیج‌کننده بودند.

words.def: To give something for a special purpose.
words.ex: The ministry allocated funds for new schools.
words.exfa: وزارت بودجه‌ای برای مکتب‌های جدید اختصاص داد.

words.def: To start talking about a subject.
words.ex: She brought up an important question at the meeting.
words.exfa: او در جلسه یک پرسش مهم را مطرح کرد.

words.def: To do or complete a task or a plan.
words.ex: The team carried out a survey in ten villages.
words.exfa: تیم در ده قریه یک سروی انجام داد.

words.def: To think of an idea or a plan.
words.ex: We need to come up with a better solution.
words.exfa: باید یک راه‌حل بهتر ارائه کنیم.

words.def: To delay something until a later time.
words.ex: They put off the trip because of the snow.
words.exfa: آنها سفر را بخاطر برف به تعویق انداختند.

words.def: A phrase used to give a different point of view.
words.ex: The job pays well; on the other hand, the hours are long.
words.exfa: این کار معاش خوب دارد؛ از طرف دیگر ساعت‌های کار طولانی است.

words.def: Over a long period of time in the future.
words.ex: Saving money will help you in the long run.
words.exfa: پس‌انداز کردن پول در درازمدت به تو کمک میکند.

words.def: To consider something when you make a decision.
words.ex: We must take the costs into account.
words.exfa: باید هزینه‌ها را در نظر بگیریم.
